title: Técnico de Telecomunicações
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Técnico de Telecomunicações em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1. Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de soluções para infraestrutura, indústria, TI, IoT, redes de comunicação, energia, utilities e projetos de engenharia.

Diferente de plataformas tradicionais de listagem de produtos, a SolutionMall oferece suporte estruturado aos clientes, incluindo esclarecimento de requisitos, seleção técnica, correspondência de produtos, coordenação com fornecedores, suporte a RFQ, cotações, entrega e acompanhamento de projetos.

Em sistemas de comunicação, a SolutionMall apoia produtos e soluções relacionados a:

  • Sistemas de comunicação sem fio
  • Produtos RF e radiocomunicação
  • Transmissão por micro-ondas
  • Comunicação por fibra óptica
  • Infraestrutura de redes e data centers
  • Comunicação industrial e IoT
  • CFTV, segurança e redes ELV
  • Cabeamento estruturado
  • Equipamentos, acessórios, ferramentas e instrumentos de teste

2. Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de Sistemas de Comunicação – Comunicação Sem Fio e RF, Brasil para apoiar o desenvolvimento de projetos de comunicação da SolutionMall no mercado brasileiro.

Esta função envolve comunicação técnica, esclarecimento de requisitos, seleção de produtos, suporte a RFQ, coordenação de cotações e acompanhamento de oportunidades relacionadas a telecomunicações, comunicação sem fio, RF, redes, IoT, segurança, data centers, integradores de sistemas e projetos de infraestrutura.

É um modelo de cooperação flexível, adequado para profissionais com experiência em comunicação sem fio, RF, sistemas de rádio, transmissão por micro-ondas, telecomunicações, comunicação industrial, IoT ou integração de sistemas.

A função não se limita à engenharia de operadoras de telecomunicações. Trata-se de uma posição técnica e de suporte a projetos, combinando conhecimento de comunicação, relacionamento com clientes, entendimento de requisitos, seleção de soluções e avanço comercial.

O candidato deverá apoiar:

  • Esclarecimento de requisitos técnicos
  • Seleção de produtos sem fio e RF
  • Correspondência de soluções de comunicação
  • Coordenação de RFQ e cotações
  • Comunicação com clientes, contratantes e integradores
  • Coordenação técnica e comercial
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Avanço de projetos

3. Principais Responsabilidades

Suporte Técnico e Apoio a Projetos

Apoiar oportunidades no Brasil relacionadas a:

  • Infraestrutura de telecomunicações
  • Comunicação sem fio e RF
  • Radiocomunicação
  • Links de micro-ondas
  • Comunicação industrial e IoT
  • Infraestrutura de redes e data centers
  • CFTV e sistemas de segurança
  • Projetos de infraestrutura e edifícios inteligentes
  • Integradores, contratantes, consultores e proprietários de projetos

Comunicar-se com clientes, contratantes, consultores, equipes de compras e demais partes envolvidas para entender contexto do projeto, requisitos técnicos, condições do local, cobertura, frequência, distância de transmissão, estrutura de rede, ambiente de instalação e direção de aquisição.

Ajudar a SolutionMall a identificar oportunidades qualificadas e avançá-las para discussões práticas de RFQ e cotação.

Seleção de Soluções Sem Fio e RF

Apoiar a seleção técnica de produtos e soluções, incluindo:

  • Equipamentos de comunicação sem fio
  • Produtos RF e radiocomunicação
  • Equipamentos de transmissão por micro-ondas
  • Antenas e acessórios RF
  • Módulos, gateways e roteadores industriais
  • Dispositivos IoT
  • Produtos de fibra óptica
  • Switches e dispositivos de rede
  • Cabeamento estruturado
  • Instrumentos de teste e ferramentas de instalação

Auxiliar clientes na escolha de produtos com base em aplicação, cobertura, distância de transmissão, estabilidade de sinal, frequência, largura de banda, ambiente, compatibilidade, instalação e manutenção.

RFQ, Cotação e Coordenação Comercial

Acompanhar informações de projeto, especificações técnicas, listas de aquisição, desenhos, orçamento, cronograma e processo de aprovação.

Converter interesses iniciais em RFQs ativos e discussões reais de cotação.

Coordenar com equipes da SolutionMall, fornecedores e clientes para manter oportunidades qualificadas em andamento.

Apoiar comparação de produtos, confirmação técnica, comunicação de cotações, negociação comercial e acompanhamento de pedidos quando necessário.

Feedback Técnico e de Mercado

Coletar e compartilhar informações sobre:

  • Demandas comuns de projetos de comunicação no Brasil
  • Necessidades de aplicação em comunicação sem fio e RF
  • Especificações preferidas
  • Expectativas de cobertura e frequência
  • Normas locais e processos de aprovação
  • Sensibilidade a preços
  • Concorrentes e canais de distribuição
  • Hábitos de compra, instalação e manutenção

Ajudar a SolutionMall a melhorar sua seleção de produtos, comunicação de projetos e estratégia de cooperação no Brasil.

4. Qualificações

Requisitos

Mais de 2 anos de experiência em uma ou mais áreas:

  • Engenharia de sistemas de comunicação
  • Comunicação sem fio ou RF
  • Radiocomunicação
  • Transmissão por micro-ondas
  • Infraestrutura de telecomunicações
  • Comunicação industrial ou IoT
  • Fibra óptica e redes
  • Data centers ou infraestrutura de rede
  • CFTV e redes de segurança
  • Integração de sistemas
  • Suporte técnico a projetos
  • Vendas técnicas ou suporte de soluções de comunicação

O candidato deve ter familiaridade com produtos de comunicação e capacidade de compreender requisitos técnicos, seleção de produtos, RFQ, cotações e comunicação com clientes.

Também é desejável compreender cobertura de sinal sem fio, comunicação RF, distância de transmissão, seleção de antenas, conectividade de rede, ambiente de instalação e cenários de aplicação.

Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com clientes, contratantes, compras, fornecedores, distribuidores e stakeholders de projetos.

Proficiência profissional em português. Inglês será considerado uma vantagem.

Preferencial

  • Relacionamento com clientes, contratantes, integradores ou projetos no Brasil
  • Experiência com telecomunicações, infraestrutura, indústria, edifícios inteligentes ou distribuidores de equipamentos de comunicação
  • Experiência em RFQ, licitações, cotações, comunicação técnico-comercial ou desenvolvimento de oportunidades
  • Conhecimento do mercado brasileiro de comunicação, aprovação de projetos, canais de aquisição e normas locais
  • Experiência com equipamentos sem fio, RF, antenas, micro-ondas, roteadores industriais, gateways IoT, fibra óptica ou instrumentos de teste

5. Modelo de Trabalho

Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação técnica e suporte a projetos.

As principais atividades incluem:

  • Esclarecimento de requisitos técnicos
  • Seleção de produtos sem fio e RF
  • Correspondência de soluções de comunicação
  • Acompanhamento de RFQ e cotações
  • Comunicação de produtos e soluções
  • Coordenação técnica e comercial
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Apoio ao avanço de projetos
  • Comunicação com clientes e contratantes

Para candidatos adequados, a SolutionMall poderá oferecer suporte regional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de negócios de longo prazo, com base na capacidade técnica, recursos de clientes, progresso dos projetos e contribuição real.

A função é adequada para profissionais com experiência ou acesso a projetos de comunicação sem fio, RF, telecomunicações, comunicação industrial, IoT, integração de sistemas ou canais de equipamentos de comunicação no Brasil.

6. Remuneração e Benefícios de Cooperação

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de cooperação vinculado ao desempenho e baseado na contribuição real, incluindo:

  • Criação de oportunidades qualificadas
  • Esclarecimento de requisitos técnicos
  • Avanço de RFQ
  • Suporte à seleção de produtos e soluções
  • Avanço de projetos
  • Resultados de pedidos e negócios
  • Valor de cooperação de longo prazo

Os termos detalhados poderão ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, conforme experiência, capacidade técnica, recursos de clientes, cobertura regional, relacionamento com projetos e contribuição real.

7. Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se com uma breve apresentação destacando sua experiência em:

  • Comunicação sem fio
  • Produtos RF
  • Radiocomunicação
  • Transmissão por micro-ondas
  • Infraestrutura de telecomunicações
  • Comunicação industrial ou IoT
  • Fibra óptica ou redes
  • Instrumentos de teste
  • Integração de sistemas ou suporte técnico a projetos
  • Mercado brasileiro de sistemas de comunicação

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Linux Systems Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer

Embedded, IoT & Edge Infrastructure

DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux

SENIORITY: Mid · Senior

EXPERIENCE: 3+ years

STACK FOCUS: Yocto · WebKit


01 About the role

We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too.


02 What you'll own

  • Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack.
  • Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86).
  • Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes.
  • Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS.
  • Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware.
  • WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime.
  • Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures.
  • Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.


03 What you bring

MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux.
  • Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree.
  • Yocto or Buildroot.
  • OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions.
  • GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante.
  • Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image.
  • Shell, C/C++, Git.
  • Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.

NICE BONUS SIGNAL

  • WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK.
  • Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack.
  • Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign.
  • Docker, CI/CD pipelines.
  • Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra.
  • Rust or Python.
  • Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS.
  • Security hardening / secure boot.


04 The kind of engineer this work asks for

  • Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads.
  • Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape.
  • Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for


APPLY

Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist


About Us:

We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it’s grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions


The Role:

We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you’re excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience
  • Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner
  • Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios
  • Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus
  • Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client’s mission
  • Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery
  • Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results
  • Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes


What we are looking for:

  • Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles
  • Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America
  • Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing


Who You Are:

  • Someone who is not satisfied with “just good enough” and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate
  • A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others
  • Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Job Description:

Our Client is the nation’s leading independent service provider for critical telecommunications and renewable energy infrastructure. As our organization continues to grow through strategic acquisitions, our cloud ecosystem must remain scalable, secure, and well‑integrated. We are seeking an AWS leader who can architect and build seamless integrations across enterprise systems.


The Role

We are looking for a Senior AWS Developer (L3) with 5–7 years of experience , strong full‑stack engineering skills , and deep expertise in designing and building cloud‑native integrations. In this role, you will lead the development of APIs and data pipelines that connect AWS services with core business systems, specifically NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise applications.

You will own the full lifecycle of integration development—from solution architecture, security design, and data modeling to hands‑on coding and deployment automation.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise System Integration

  • Architect, build, and maintain integrations between AWS , NetSuite , Salesforce , and other enterprise systems.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs , event‑driven integrations, and data‑sync pipelines.
  • Lead integration efforts during M&A system consolidation , ensuring that data, logic, and system flows unify cleanly across legacy platforms.

AWS Engineering & Architecture

  • Build serverless and microservices‑based applications using Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , RDS , EventBridge , SNS/SQS , and related AWS services.
  • Develop secure, scalable backend solutions, including authentication, access control, observability, and resilience patterns.

Full‑Stack Development

  • Contribute to both backend and frontend engineering using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
  • Build dashboards, administrative tools, and workflow components that support business integration processes.

Advanced Development & Data Workflows

  • Design and maintain high performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).‑performance data transformations between platforms (Salesforce ↔ NetSuite ↔ AWS).
  • Implement robust ETL/ELT patterns for large‑scale data migrations and cross‑platform synchronization.
  • Perform deep‑dive field mapping, data normalization, and validation across systems.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Produce clear architectural diagrams, sequence flows, and Build‑vs‑Buy recommendations.
  • Lead technical discussions with internal teams and stakeholders from acquired companies.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

  • 5–7 years professional software engineering experience with increasing seniority.
  • Expert level AWS development experience , especially with serverless and eventdriven architectures.‑level AWS development experience ‑driven architectures.
  • Strong full‑stack engineering background (JavaScript / TypeScript preferred).
  • Proven track record developing REST APIs , microservices, and cloud‑native applications.
  • Hands‑on experience integrating with NetSuite (SuiteTalk, SuiteScript) and Salesforce APIs .
  • Strong data modeling skills and experience with large‑scale migration tooling.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD and DevOps tooling (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset, etc.).

Soft Skills

  • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to document architectures clearly.
  • Strong analytical and root‑cause debugging skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross‑functional business and engineering teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with EventBridge , AppFlow , or enterprise iPaaS tools.
  • Background in M&A system consolidation or multi‑system enterprise architecture.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Veeva Support Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Required Skills & Experience


• Experience with the life science and healthcare industry.

• Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and validation processes in a regulated environment.

• Strong technical skills in configuration, and issue resolution in Windows-based enterprise environments.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow) and Request/ incident/change management processes.

• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus.


Job Description


A large pharmaceutical client is looking for Veeva Support Analyst to join their team. This role provides comprehensive technical support and system management across multiple regulatory and document management platforms. Responsibilities include end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs Vaults, encompassing issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive monitoring. The position collaborates with BOT development teams to deliver Veeva RIM API endpoints for automation and integration, and contributes to configuring the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite to ensure streamlined compliance tracking. Acting as the technical point of contact for PleaseReview (both standalone and Veeva-integrated), the role manages user access, configuration, performance optimization, and license administration. Additional duties include setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, lifecycle management of Lorenz docuBridge (including user provisioning and licensing), and support for Lorenz iSubmit installation, configuration, and issue resolution to meet submission standards. The role also involves configuring Word Templates for regulatory workflows, installing and troubleshooting iLovePDF and other document processing tools for high-volume submissions, and managing ServiceNow Request and Incident tickets to ensure timely resolution of customer escalations. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM, working US ET hours.


Compensation :

$20/hr to $25/hr.

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

description:

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em IA Generativa , com forte domínio técnico e capacidade de influenciar decisões arquiteturais e estratégicas. Essa posição atua de forma transversal, apoiando a evolução da plataforma de LLMOps e a entrega de soluções de alto impacto para o negócio. Construção e evolução de soluções de IA Generativa que suportam jornadas críticas do banco, integrando modelos, dados e plataformas com alto padrão de engenharia. Foco está em escalar o uso de LLMs de forma segura, governada e sustentável, apoiando produtos, operações e áreas internas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:


• Desenvolver soluções de IA Generativa de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção técnica até a operação em produção.

• Liderar ou apoiar a criação de copilots, automações e assistentes para clientes e áreas internas, garantindo qualidade, segurança e escalabilidade.

• Evoluir a plataforma de LLMOps com foco em governança, rastreabilidade, observabilidade, custo e segurança.

• Atuar de forma integrada com times de arquitetura, engenharia, produto e operações na definição e implementação de soluções com impacto direto no negócio.

• Definir e disseminar boas práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a IA Generativa, em ambientes on-premise e cloud.

• Investigar falhas e incidentes em produção, conduzindo análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais.

• Promover boas práticas técnicas, revisão de código, padronização de soluções e compartilhamento de conhecimento entre os times.

Perfil esperado:


• Comunicação clara e objetiva com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

• Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica ou forte influência como referência no time.

• Habilidade para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis e sustentáveis.

• Postura colaborativa, com senso de ownership e foco em entrega contínua.

• Vivência em ambientes ágeis, com visão de produto e melhoria incremental.

Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs, embeddings e técnicas de NLP.

• Domínio de Python e de bibliotecas e frameworks como LangChain, Transformers ou equivalentes.

• Experiência avançada com arquiteturas de RAG, incluindo técnicas como re-ranking, chunking dinâmico e recuperação sensível a contexto.

• Conhecimento sólido em Git e bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Vivência em Ciência de Dados aplicada a dados não estruturados.

• Experiência prática com LLMOps, incluindo pipelines, versionamento, monitoramento, avaliação e controle de custo de modelos.


Diferenciais:


• Experiência com modelos open-source como Mistral, LLaMA, Mixtral e Phi.

• Atuação com agentes autônomos ou orquestração de fluxos com LangGraph ou ferramentas similares.

• Conhecimento de protocolos e padrões emergentes como MCP e A2A.

title: Sr AI Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr AI Engineer - Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer


PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTO

A trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it.

PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop.

We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it.

Why this role exists

We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound.

If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you.

This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them.

Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.

What you'll build

The voice-to-action pipeline.  Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab.

The recommendation engine.  Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue.

The credit scoring models.  Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals.

The data flywheel.  Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence.

US market integrations.  Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.

What you bring

3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.  Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways.

NLP or voice experience.  You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments.

Full-stack ML instincts.  You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team.

Builder mentality.  You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter.

Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.  You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.


Requirements


Timezone:  Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async.

Commitment:  This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%.

Travel:  Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.


What makes this different

At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day.

You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality.

And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: BI Operations Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para BI Operations Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time BI Operations Specialist with 2 to 4 years of experience to manage the daily health and evolution of the data visualization layer. In this role, while the Lead Analytics Engineer will handle high-level architecture and new project intake, you will be the primary point of contact for end-users. Your mission is to ensure that once a tool is launched, it remains accurate, useful, and high-performing. You will handle the \"last mile\" of data-managing user feedback, making tactical adjustments to dashboards, and ensuring the business is getting maximum value from our existing tools. You will work directly under the Lead Analytics Engineer, and you will be the \"boots on the ground\" for the Domo environment.

Our US-based client is a trusted national provider of end-to-end outsourced yard logistics. They specialize in sustainable, optimized enterprise yard and transportation services and solutions for all-sized yards across retail, manufacturing, and distribution sectors. They offer decades of proven expertise from working with large shippers, leading Silicon Valley companies, and top-tier consulting firms to provide reliable, high-performance services, all while lowering the total cost of your operations.

Their deep understanding of the operational challenges from multiple perspectives and their commitment to operational excellence, sustainability, and implementing cutting-edge technology make our client the go-to partner for enterprises seeking world-class yard logistics solutions.


Responsibilities

  • User Success & Support: Act as the first point of contact for end-user inquiries, troubleshooting visualization issues, and clarifying data definitions for the team
  • Dashboard Maintenance: Perform ongoing adjustments, cosmetic improvements, and layout updates to existing Domo dashboards and apps based on user feedback
  • Usage Monitoring: Proactively track user adoption and engagement metrics within Domo to identify which tools are providing value and which need refinement
  • Data Validation (Front-End): Write SQL in Snowflake to verify that the numbers appearing in Domo match the source data, ensuring a high level of data trust across the company
  • Incremental Enhancements: Translate small-scale user requests (new filters, additional charts, modified logic) into reality without needing constant architectural oversight
  • Documentation: Keep user-facing documentation and data dictionaries up to date as dashboards evolve


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI-focused role
  • Experience with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Domo, etc
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries to explore and validate data within Snowflake
  • Ability to pivot between multiple small tasks, moving from a bug fix to a layout adjustment to a user training session seamlessly
  • Clear and empathetic communication style for helping users navigate data tools


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Jira, GitHub, and Confluence
  • Familiarity with the yard management industry
  • Awareness of logistics and supply chain management


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient


We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC).


Primary Job Duties:

  • Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time.
  • Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work.
  • Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision.
  • Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design.
  • Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures.
  • Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings.
  • Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis.
  • Improve system reliability through automation and observability.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git).
  • Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly.
  • Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required.
  • Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity.
  • AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer.
  • Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly.
  • Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.


This is a CLT role and not open to PJ.

Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

title: Médico Oncologista Genético (com RQE)
description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

title: Senior Automation Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Automation Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuação no suporte e sustentação da plataforma de automação de workloads, incluindo atendimento de tickets, troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes complexos.
  • Participação ativa no processo de migração da ferramenta Automation Engine (UC4) para o RunMyJobs, incluindo preparação de ambientes, suporte pós-migração e estabilização da aplicação.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de scripts e automações para suporte às operações do time.
  • Suporte à infraestrutura Windows e colaboração com equipes globais para resolução de problemas críticos.
  • Monitoramento e suporte a aplicações críticas, garantindo estabilidade, disponibilidade e melhoria contínua do ambiente.


Responsabilidades do cargo:

  • Atuar no suporte técnico e operacional de ferramentas de Job Scheduling e automação de workloads.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado, análise de causa raiz e resolução de incidentes em ambiente produtivo.
  • Apoiar a migração e estabilização da plataforma RunMyJobs, garantindo continuidade operacional.
  • Desenvolver scripts e automações utilizando linguagens de programação como Python e Java.
  • Executar atividades relacionadas à infraestrutura Windows e suporte a ambientes corporativos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times globais, incluindo interação com equipes internacionais.
  • Participar de escalas de suporte On Call em finais de semana conforme necessidade do time.



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com suporte técnico e troubleshooting de aplicações críticas.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Job Scheduling, como Automation Engine/UC4, Control-M ou Autosys.
  • Experiência com suporte e desenvolvimento utilizando RunMyJobs será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais.
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Azure.
  • Experiência com programação/scripting utilizando Python e Java.
  • Conhecimentos em infraestrutura Windows.
  • Capacidade analítica e habilidade para resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Inglês avançado para suporte e interação com times globais.
